decisions.statement: A rule is set against the rule of the same id the configuration holds.
The rules compiled here carry the rules automation controls, as the configuration does.
Two values hold the same thing whatever order their keys are written in.
A rule on one side and not on the other is a divergence.
The rule closing the compiled order carries no id, so nothing is set against it.

definition: the rules the records compile to, set against the rules the configuration the addon reads holds
